evidence: Changes the wallet RPC interface and spend logic in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp for walletprocesspsbt.
rationale: Adopting an options parameter for walletprocesspsbt replaces clumsy boolean chains and unblocks planned parameter expansions such as PR #32857. The description notes that positional calls currently require multiple sequential booleans ('walletprocesspsbt "psbt" true "ALL" true false') and adding further settings without an options object becomes increasingly unwieldy.
